title: Logical time and advancement policies proposed definition
description: Standalone design contract; current ScenarioEngine loading support is not implemented.

policy.description: Registered policy determines permitted advancement boundaries.

unit.description: Explicit integer unit; never infer the unit from Tick.

fixedDelta.description: Zero for action/calendar modes; fixed mode requires a positive value.

maximumAdvance.description: Cap one requested interval; stop at required event boundaries.
